-- Let me get all 104 rows to see the complete list
WITH first_last AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, first_round, last_round,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY first_round ASC) as rn_first,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY last_round DESC) as rn_last
    FROM drives 
    WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
first_last_con AS (
    SELECT fl1.year, fl1.driver_id, fl1.constructor_id as first_constructor, fl2.constructor_id as last_constructor,
           fl1.first_round as first_round_val, fl2.last_round as last_round_val
    FROM first_last fl1
    JOIN first_last fl2 ON fl1.year = fl2.year AND fl1.driver_id = fl2.driver_id
    WHERE fl1.rn_first = 1 AND fl2.rn_last = 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname
FROM first_last_con flc
JOIN drivers d ON flc.driver_id = d.driver_id
WHERE flc.first_constructor = flc.last_constructor
  AND flc.first_constructor != -1
  AND flc.first_round_val != flc.last_round_val
ORDER BY d.surname, d.forename
